history: Shaoxing has 2,500 years of city history — ancient Yuezhou, capital of the Yue kingdom. Black-awning boats rock under stone bridges; yellow wine warms a thousand years. Wang Xizhi wrote the world's finest calligraphy at Lanting; Lu Xun's Baicao Garden and Three-Flavor Study, Lu You and Tang Wan's Shen Garden, Wang Yangming's cave — the literary vein never breaks.
importance: Hometown of Lu Xun · Water town of wine
foods: Daughter Red and Scholar Red wines, warmed, with fennel beans.
Kong Yiji's 'not many more, not many'.
Dried mustard greens steamed with pork belly.
Chicken soaked in yellow wine — the aroma everywhere.
Shaoxing stinky tofu with sweet sauce.
A century-old shop's little pastry — ancestor of egg tarts.
Wine-lees shrimp — fresher with every bite.
scenes: Baicao Garden and the Three-Flavor Study — the textbook Shaoxing.
The love garden of Lu You and Tang Wan's 'Phoenix Hairpin'.
Wang Xizhi's floating-cup stream and the Lanting Preface.
Cliff, water and stone bonsai — boats through the caves.
The home of advisors, fragrant with sausage.
Burial place of Yu the Great, the flood tamer.
Where Yu met the lords — birthplace of yellow wine.
